links.comparator_used: Same avatar video instructions presented without disclosure of AI identity
links.outcome: Intention to comply with instructions and reported likelihood of returning to the same dentist
links.effect: AI disclosure did not affect intention to comply; it reduced the reported likelihood of returning to the same dentist (no numeric effect sizes given in abstract). Experiment 1, n=650.
links.tradeoff: Disclosure reduced patients' reported likelihood of returning to the same dentist, a trust or retention cost.
links.quote: AI disclosure did not affect intention to comply but reduced the reported likelihood of returning to the same dentist.
